note: Local protocol freeze before first candidate experiment; Git records subsequent revisions. Not a signed timestamp.
selection: Choose positive training accuracy edge versus the best constant direction on identical signaled rows; ties by coverage then id. Never select by test result.

rules.name: 3日短期反轉
rules.rule: RSI<=30 and close<=MA20-0.5ATR: bullish; RSI>=70 and close>=MA20+0.5ATR: bearish; else abstain

rules.name: 3日突破延續
rules.rule: MA5>MA20, close>previous 3-bar high, volumeRatio>=1.2: bullish; mirrored bearish; else abstain

rules.name: 3日高門檻觀察
rules.rule: v4 score>=85: bullish; <=15: bearish; else abstain

rules.name: 5日反轉確認
rules.rule: RSI<=35, close<=MA20-1.5ATR and close>previous close: bullish; RSI>=65, close>=MA20+1.5ATR and close<previous close: bearish; else abstain

rules.name: 5日趨勢延續
rules.rule: MA20>MA60, close>MA20, MACD>signal, volumeRatio>=1: bullish; mirrored bearish; else abstain

rules.name: 5日高門檻觀察
rules.rule: v4 score>=75: bullish; <=25: bearish; else abstain

promotion: No automatic replacement. Require forward evidence after freeze, adequate signaled samples, coverage, baseline and cost comparisons; permit rejection of every candidate.

requirements: positive edge versus same-window constant baseline
positive net return and advantage versus fixed-long after costs
